activities.description: Title card with fire animation and music

mood.description: Excited - The fiery visuals, intense music, and brief glimpses of action-packed gameplay create a hype atmosphere.

narrativeProgression.description: Introduces the game's title and sets an action-packed tone.

videoEditingDetails.description: Fast cuts between logos and title card, fire animation and sound effects create a sense of excitement

activities.description: Pony and Biki run through various levels, fighting enemies.
The Boss appears with a treasure chest, showcasing his role as the antagonist.
Gameplay footage showcasing combat, level design, boss battles, and the game's humor.

characterInteraction.description: Pony and Biki are shown working together, highlighting their partnership.
The Boss is shown as a demanding figure, creating conflict.

scenes.contextualRelevance: The pixelated art style and over-the-top action create a nostalgic nod to classic arcade games.

mood.description: Excited -  Fast-paced action, upbeat music, and over-the-top visuals contribute to the excited and chaotic energy.

narrativeProgression.description: Establishes the core gameplay loop of running, shooting, and fighting enemies, while hinting at a larger quest to recover a stolen treasure.

props.name: Various environmental elements within the game world

scenes.title: Scene 2

videoEditingDetails.description: Fast cuts between gameplay segments. Text overlays introduce gameplay elements ("PURE RUN'N'GUN GAME," "WITH PANDA," "NINJA POWER," "MIXED WITH RPG")

activities.description: Pony finds a panda in a cage and frees it.
More fast-paced gameplay, highlighting platforming challenges, boss fights, and humorous moments.

characterInteraction.description: The relationship between Pony and Biki is further emphasized as they work together.

scenes.contextualRelevance: The inclusion of humor suggests that the game doesn't take itself too seriously, aiming for a lighthearted and fun experience.

mood.description: Excited, Humorous -  The addition of over-the-top and absurd situations, like fighting inside a giant body or freeing a panda, amplifies the game's humorous side.

narrativeProgression.description: Introduces a possible side-quest element (saving the panda) while continuing to showcase the diversity of the gameplay.

scenes.title: Scene 3

videoEditingDetails.description: Continues the fast-paced editing style from Scene 2. Text overlay emphasizes the game's humor ("WITH AN OFF-THE-WALL SENSE OF HUMOR")

activities.description: The characters dance against a static background. The text "SOON AVAILABLE ON STEAM PC/MAC/LINUX" is displayed.

characterInteraction.description: The characters' dancing suggests camaraderie and celebration.

mood.description: Excited - despite minimal action, the scene maintains excitement through the music and the announcement of the game's upcoming release.

narrativeProgression.description: Concludes the trailer by building anticipation for the game's release.

videoEditingDetails.description: Static background with minimal animation. Text overlay dominates the screen, providing release information.

climax.description: The final confrontation with The Boss is implied but not shown in the trailer.

storylines.description: The main storyline follows Pony and Biki as they seek to retrieve a priceless treasure stolen by The Boss, traveling across the world and facing various enemies. The climax is implied to be a final confrontation with The Boss.

youtube_description:
The music is composed by Frédéric Sommer at Le Cortex Studio. 
The CD can be purchased on their online shop (http://www.lecortex.com/shop) but the track which was used for the trailer was produced later. 

Senseï is an undisputed chieftain. His followers are used to every martial, extortion and infiltration practices. Pony and Biki are his best students, his true pride. This duet masters the chakra techniques on their fingertips and hoofs. Together, they rule the city and its surroundings. 

Although everyone respects and fears them, they are hunted by the law enforcement.
They are Ninjas ...
